AUDIT_REPAIRS_2026_10_24.what_was_wrong: Called the source 'the long open-label paediatric series' and its finding 'the paediatric nerve signal', and leaned the age split on that label.
AUDIT_REPAIRS_2026_10_24.source: Abdelmalak 2013 artefact: 'Patients (1 adult) ranged in age from 3.5 to 40.2 years at the start of DCA administration and are currently aged 16.9 to 49.9 years'; authors' scope 'at least from young childhood through early adulthood'; 8 patients (4 males), PDC E1a or respiratory-chain, 9.7 to 16.5 years.
AUDIT_REPAIRS_2026_10_24.repair: Population restated as the source gives it, headline rewritten. The age-modifier sentence re-examined: what it supports is EXPOSURE (metabolism inversely proportional to age, GSTZ1 clearance), not symptom status — because the nerve effect 'persisted longest ... in patient 8, who ... is the oldest subject to be chronically treated with the drug' and was still asymptomatic. The paediatric/adult symptom contrast is recorded as NOT explained by this paper, which postulates technical variability, disease waxing and waning, chronic exposure and advancing age together.

AUDIT_REPAIRS_2026_10_24.what_was_wrong: Claimed the guideline's strongest word on the functional route is 'most likely not eligible', not 'cannot'. That was produced by stopping the quotation one sentence early.
AUDIT_REPAIRS_2026_10_24.source: Data S1, same paragraph, two sentences later: 'Variants that fully abolish canonical splicing are not amenable to a splice correction ASO and are classified as "not eligible" for this approach.' Eligibility table: 'Not eligible — Canonical splice site and branchpoints are destroyed OR ... OR Variant within 5 bp of the canonical splice site'.
AUDIT_REPAIRS_2026_10_24.repair: Fuller quotation carried, the flat form and the table criterion restored, headline rewritten so the guideline's force is not understated. The narrowing is relocated to where it belongs: the flat verdict applies to variants that 'fully abolish canonical splicing', and whether the reference acceptor allele is in that class has never been measured; the 5-bp criterion needs no measurement, so the class verdict stands on position while the functional route stays unevidenced.

AUDIT_REPAIRS_2026_10_24.repair: Full restricted sentence quoted; the neuronal system cited as its own sentence with its own system description and n = 2-4 per cell line.
